name: Wellington Solar Farm
notable: 170 MW solar farm near Wellington, NSW. Developed by Lightsource BP. Located in the Central-West Orana REZ.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Wellington Solar Farm Environmental Impact Statement (SSD-8573) - First Solar (Australia)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Wellington 330 kV substation (TransGrid, ~150 m south of development footprint)
eis_specs.connection_distance_note: New 1,270 m 330 kV OHL from onsite BESS/switchyard to TransGrid Wellington 330 kV substation
eis_specs.notes: First Solar (Australia) - developed then sold to Lightsource bp, and again to Aula Energy in 2026. ~174 MWac approved (180 MW peak in some references) on ~559 ha, 2 km NE of Wellington. First Solar CdTe thin-film PV modules on single-axis trackers. Existing 330 kV OHL crosses site.
